text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The morning of the New Year is calm
and
tranquil...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until the peace is suddenly shattered by
some
shocking news!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Dawn of the Ultimate Era! Renowned
runners
sprint back into the limelight!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news! A group of racers who
returned to
the track yesterday after a
long hiatus have just
finished a press
conference.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
They've all announced their intention to
step
back onto the G1 tracks this year!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Each of them is a fierce contender with a
storied
resume under her belt.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki! Why did you decide to
announce your
participation in the G1 at
this time?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That's a difficult question... If I
had to say,
it's because we want to be an
obstacle.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All of us here are joining the races to
pose a
monumental challenge to our
younger peers.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know you're out there—we're waiting
for you
and excited for the challenge.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
This new and exciting era is truly just
getting
started! This year's races are
shaping up to be
something special!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: An obstacle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash looks shaken after watching
the news
report.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It can't be... This can't be happening...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Are you telling me I must face foes of
their caliber
once again?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I've done well in my races
thus far.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, I know the full extent of their

capabilities, and I'm not sure I'll be able
to
overcome them this time...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The races will be even fiercer with their

participation. My chances of winning will
surely
drop...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But with that said...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I just promised to show my parents how
much I
have grown.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's looking like I might not be able to
keep my
promise to them...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "A little"? How much is that, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And what do you mean by "calm down"?
Do I not
appear calm at the moment?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shock of the news is sending Eishin
Flash into
a rapid spiral. A change in
scenery would do her
good right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to take her out to do our first
shrine visit
of the year, but...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see the news?! This year's
races are
gonna be sick!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
No kidding. I'll be watching every
second of them.
I do feel bad for the
younger racers, though.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, just think of how tough it'll be
for the
racers who just entered their
classic year to run
against opponents
like that.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Dang, that's true... Those poor
newcomers...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Something else... Like what, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash has shown a keen interest in
Japanese
culture before, so that could
be just the ticket
right now!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Is that really something to be so
enthusiastic
about?
choice_data_list: Let's spend New Year's sleeping in!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that makes sense... All is
dependent
upon one's intention, after
all.
choice_data_list: Making a decision and acting on it is what matters!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Falcon has previously recommended I try
"lazing
around" too, so I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the suggestion. I shall
refresh
myself with a fifteen-minute nap.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I had a wonderful dream in which a bird
named
Mambo flew toward Mount Fuji
and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash looks much better after a
quick nap
in my office.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I know about this tradition. We are to
write on a
wooden plaque called a
"prayer tablet," correct?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've been interested in this custom for
some time,
but since we can only do it
once a year, I haven't
had the chance to
try it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. I believe that's the booth over
there...
choice_data_list: All the more reason to do it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wrote, "I wish to carry out my schedule

perfectly."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I live by those words. What did you
write?
choice_data_list: You really never waver, do you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I show her my plaque, on which I wrote,
"I hope
Eishin Flash can carry out her
schedule perfectly
without overexerting
herself."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You saw right through me... I'm
not at all
surprised.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My relief is immeasurable when Eishin
Flash finally
cracks a small smile.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Right now? But I thought that the
custom in
Japan was to send New Year's
cards in advance of
New Year's Day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean to say it would not be a
cultural
faux pas to exchange cards in
person?
choice_data_list: Since it stems from the tradition of New Year's greeting rounds.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Let's ready some cards at
once.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We go buy New Year's cards, write
messages, and
exchange them on the
spot. When I hand my card
to Eishin
Flash...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? I'm pretty good at
replicating
photos on paper if I do say so
myself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping for a chance to show you
this, so this
is perfect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shows me her New Year's card
proudly. On it
is an anatomically correct
drawing of a ladybug
with the phrase
"Fortune unto you" in Japanese.
